/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/components/CpuLoadChart.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(\"  const theme = useThemeValue();\\n  const chartRef = useRef<Yagr | null>(null);\\n  const lastValueRef = useRef(55);\", \"  const theme = useThemeValue();\\n  const chartRef = useRef<Yagr | null>(null);\\n  const lastValueRef = useRef(55);\\n  const initialThemeRef = useRef(theme as YagrTheme);\")
s=s.replace(\"        appearance: {\\n          theme: theme as YagrTheme,\\n          locale: 'ru',\\n        },\", \"        appearance: {\\n          theme: initialThemeRef.current,\\n          locale: 'ru',\\n        },\")
s=s.replace(\"  const config = useMemo<MinimalValidConfig>(\\n    () => ({\", \"  const config = useMemo<MinimalValidConfig>(\\n    () => ({\")
s=s.replace(\"    [theme, initialData],\\n  );\", \"    [initialData],\\n  );\")
s=s.replace(\"  const handleChartLoad = useCallback((chart: Yagr) => {\\n    chartRef.current = chart;\\n  }, []);\", \"  const handleChartLoad = useCallback((chart: Yagr) => {\\n    chartRef.current = chart;\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  useEffect(() => {\\n    chartRef.current?.setTheme(theme as YagrTheme);\\n  }, [theme]);\")
p.write_text(s)
PY"
